rss: Households warned gas price spike could pile fresh pressure on energy bills
title: Energy Prices Rise, Bills May Increase
story: Energy costs are going up because there's not enough stored energy. Families might have to pay more to keep their houses warm.
storyBig: The energy market is facing pressure due to low energy storage levels, which could result in higher prices for consumers. This situation may lead households to experience increased energy bills.
think: What are some ways to save energy at home?
bull: Learning how to save energy can help families spend less!
bear: Higher energy costs mean families might have to pay more.

rss: Why wait? Business grads buying firms to install themselves as CEO
title: Young Leaders Buy Companies, Become CEOs
story: Some young people are borrowing money to buy businesses so they can be the boss. They want to lead companies right away!
storyBig: Recent business graduates are securing loans to purchase companies, allowing them to rapidly advance to CEO positions. This trend highlights a proactive approach to leadership and entrepreneurship.
think: What would you do if you were the CEO of a company?
bull: Young leaders bring fresh ideas and energy to companies.
bear: Buying companies can be risky if the business doesn't do well.
